Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

No third-party books, quotations, personal information, fonts, images or other
restricted resources are included. Names, sentences and repeated long-book
content are invented solely for testing. Generation requires no network.
manifest.json records provenance, purpose, byte sizes and SHA-256 checksums.
missing-toc.epub, malformed.epub and malformed-utf8.txt are intentionally
nonconforming negative cases; they must not be described as valid books.
